outputs: Natural language descriptive summaries of assembly code

datasets: Manually constructed dataset for binary code summarization

changes_made.explanation: Added 'Code Generation' as this is fundamentally a code-to-text generation task. Consolidated dataset names to 'CP-BCS Dataset'. Removed duplicate output description.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE base form according to simplification guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper

guideline: Volunteers evaluate generated summaries on Similarity (how similar to ground-truth), Fluency (syntactic correctness and naturalness), and Time-Cost (reverse engineering efficiency improvement)

changes_made.explanation: All extracted metadata was accurate and properly normalized

overall_notes: This paper addresses binary code summarization (assembly code to natural language descriptions), which is a specialized form of code generation/text summarization. The extraction quality was generally good with minor normalization needed. The paper includes comprehensive evaluation with both automatic metrics and human evaluation.
